{{Quote|I'm a soldier&hellip;my duty is to the Empire!|Imperial Commander|<ref name="Tatooine Sojourn">"[[Tatooine Sojourn]]"</ref>}}
An '''Imperial commander''' was the commander of the [[Imperial garrison base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

After [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], in a misguided attempt at rescuing [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], attempted to breach the base with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawler]], the commander promptly ordered for the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be destroyed. Skywalker, however, was lurking nearby and held the commander hostage. He then pointed out that he was still infected with [[Bledsoe's disease]] (which was technically true, as the [[Serum (Bledsoe's disease)|vaccination]] he took hadn't fully kicked in yet), and also implied that he'll take the commander down with him by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] blaster fire if he doesn't let the droids go. However, the commander ordered for the Stormtroopers to fire on him anyhow, as he preferred to die loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, the Stormtroopers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Anduvil]], and the commander was instead captured and brought onto Skywalker's ship as insurance to leave the system, with the base being destroyed from Anduvil's earlier sabotage.
